name: Cat Skull Deathblow (Combat)
body:
Eliminate the problem by eliminating their defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, BAB +7, Cat Skull Combat, Cat Skull Repulsion, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: While using this style, you may forgo confirming a critical hit to make a feint instead. This attack only counts for your or an ally’s next attack. Until that attack, the target counts as unaware of you, but may still make attacks against you at no penalty. You may make a melee attack as a full-round action with an unarmed strike against an unaware target. This attack automatically threatens a critical hit.

Special: This style’s benefit applies to light weapons, natural weapons, and one-handed weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
